kind: Historical analogue episodes for the IMPACT layer RATE CONTEXT block. Static, versioned, hand-verified data. Every entry is HISTORICAL evidence about a past episode — never a forecast, never interpolated onto a current event.
matching_rule: Analogues are selected by channel match (closure/reroute analogues for reroute chains, congestion analogues for queue/congestion chains) and shown side-by-side with the current chain's served numbers. The panel never interpolates between the analogue and the present.
